items.title: Free for Dev
items.content_text:
### Security and PKI

*   [pkgscan.dev](https://pkgscan.dev) - Multi-engine supply chain scanner for npm, PyPI, VS Code extensions, Cargo, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems, Go and AI agent skills. Checks for malware and known vulnerabilities, including hash lookups that need no upload. Free tier: 5 scans per month with full findings.

### Feature Toggles Management Platforms

*   [Featureflip](https://featureflip.io/) - Featureflip is a full featured feature flag platform that removes its own dead flags by submitting its own pull requests. Free plan includes 10 flags, 2 environments, 1 project, 3 users, and no usage caps.

items.title: Awesome Osint
items.content_text:
### People Investigations / GitHub

*   [recap-cli (⭐0)](https://github.com/NPCmillionaire/recap-cli) - Free, open-source CLI to search and download U.S. federal court dockets and documents from the RECAP archive (CourtListener). Free API token required.

### Company Research / GitHub

*   [capitol-cli (⭐0)](https://github.com/NPCmillionaire/capitol-cli) - Free, open-source CLI that tracks U.S. House members' stock trades from official STOCK Act filings, with committee cross-references and late-filing flags.
*   [govint (⭐0)](https://github.com/NPCmillionaire/govint) - Free CLI that searches U.S. government records (SEC EDGAR, sanctions lists, USAspending, GLEIF, FEC, SAM.gov, FARA and more) for a company or person, links the results, and writes a sourced dossier.

### Privacy and Encryption Tools / GitHub

*   [Free Proxy List (⭐7k)](https://github.com/proxifly/free-proxy-list) - Free HTTP, SOCKS4 and SOCKS5 proxies, tested and refreshed every 5 minutes, with lists by country. Useful for routing research traffic away from an investigator's own IP.

items.title: ALL About RSS
items.content_text:
### Hosted Readers / Outline Processor Markup Language

*   [IntelCue RSS Reader](https://www.intelcue.ai/tools/rss-reader): free web reader with no signup and no feed limit, keeps subscriptions, read marks and saved items in browser local storage, auto-discovers a feed from a site URL, and supports OPML import/export, full-text search and a keyword watchlist ![Online](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-web-design-16.png)![Freeware](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-one-free-16.png)

### Self Hosted Readers / Outline Processor Markup Language

*   [reader](https://dev.standardbeagle.com/reader/) : Google Reader clone with three-pane UI, OPML import, snooze, saved lists with public RSS, Mastodon/Bluesky/Reddit ingestors with optional LLM filtering; Electron desktop or hosted web service from one TypeScript codebase. ([Demo](https://dev.standardbeagle.com/reader/demo/)) [![Open-Source Software](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/open-source.png)](https://github.com/standardbeagle/reader)![AI](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-ai-16.png)[![MCP](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-model-context-protocol-16.png)](https://github.com/standardbeagle/reader#readme)

### RSS Feed integrated with AI generated content / Webpage Monitor Services with capability of monitoring RSS Feed [1264](https://t.me/s/aboutrss/1264)

*   [~~RSSPath~~](http://www.rsspath.com/) <sup>[1363](https://t.me/s/aboutrss/1363)</sup> ![AI](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-ai-16.png)

### RSS Feed Finding/Detection / Webpage Monitor Services with capability of monitoring RSS Feed [1264](https://t.me/s/aboutrss/1264)

*   [IntelCue RSS Finder](https://www.intelcue.ai/tools/rss-finder): paste any site URL and get its RSS/Atom feed URLs, no signup ![Online](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-web-design-16.png)![Freeware](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-one-free-16.png)

### 🏗️ Tools for parsing / decoding RSS / Webpage Monitor Services with capability of monitoring RSS Feed [1264](https://t.me/s/aboutrss/1264)

*   [Feedsmith](https://feedsmith.dev/): A fast JavaScript and TypeScript library for parsing and generating RSS, Atom, RDF, JSON Feed and OPML, with support for 30+ namespaces [![Open-Source Software](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/open-source.png)](https://github.com/macieklamberski/feedsmith)

Screenshots

* [OS-intent (⭐8)](https://github.com/vdk888/os-intent) ![macOS 14.0++](https://img.shields.io/badge/macOS-14.0+%2B-blue) - Learns how you work and puts your likely next action one key away, with every outward action behind a confirm panel. **Languages:** Swift Python
Screenshots

items.content_text:
### Reading and Writing Tools / Markdown Tools [![Awesome List](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-awesome.svg "Awesome List")](https://github.com/BubuAnabelas/awesome-markdown#tools)

*   [Splat (⭐4)](https://github.com/sventmueller/splat) - Native macOS Markdown editor in Rust where both the source and the live preview are editable. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/sventmueller/splat) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

### Developer Tools / Developer Utilities

*   [tapflow](https://tapflow.dev) - Self-hosted tool for testing iOS simulators and Android emulators from the browser, on Macs your team already owns. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/jo-duchan/tapflow) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Audio and Video Tools / Audio Record and Process

*   [Vauta](https://vauta.vercel.app/) - Open-source meeting notes app that transcribes any call on device, tells speakers apart and writes cited minutes with Apple Intelligence or your own local model server. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/MaquinaTech/Vauta) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Utilities / Clipboard Tools

*   [Clipivo](https://clipivo.jishnumahanta.in) - Local-first native clipboard manager that keeps your clipboard history searchable, organized, and private. ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

### Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

*   [AI Meter (⭐1)](https://github.com/getguruhat/ai-meter) - Shows your remaining Claude Code or Codex usage and reset time in the menu bar. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/getguruhat/ai-meter) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Utilities / General Tools

*   [AerialSwap (⭐2)](https://github.com/mxpalm/AerialSwap) - Turn any video into a native Aerial wallpaper for the lock screen and desktop, in its own group in System Settings. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/mxpalm/AerialSwap) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

items.title: Awesome Amazon Seller
items.content_text:
### Software and Tools

*   [BulkBarcode Generator](https://bulkbarcode-generator.com) - Makes FNSKU, UPC, EAN-13, Code 128 and QR labels in bulk from an Excel or CSV file, and exports print-ready PDF rolls for thermal printers. Runs in the browser. Free plan.
*   [CorpusIQ](https://www.corpusiq.io) - Connects ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity read-only to Amazon Seller, Shopify, GA4, QuickBooks and 40+ other systems, and answers questions about the business with the source of each number. From $29.95 a month, with a 30-day free trial.
*   [Fbaleaks](https://fbaleaks.com) - Audits FBA inventory and reimbursement reports in the browser. Finds lost or damaged units that Amazon did not reimburse, sorts SKUs to keep, reprice or remove, and drafts appeal letters. Free tools and a one-time paid audit.
*   [PixVibe](https://pixvibe.ai/tools/remove-background) - Browser-based background remover that exports product photos on a white or transparent background, with tools to compress, resize and crop images. Free for single images, with no account.
*   [TranslateMyImage](https://translatemyimage.com/amazon-image-translator) - Translates the text inside product images, infographics, A+ modules and size charts into other languages, and keeps the original layout. Works from the final JPG or PNG files. Three free test images.

### Product Research and Pre-Launch

*   [Trends MCP](https://www.trendsmcp.ai) - MCP server and REST API with trend data from Amazon, Google Search, Google Shopping, TikTok, YouTube and other sources, for demand research in an AI assistant. Free plan with 100 requests a month. [GitHub (⭐44)](https://github.com/trendsmcp-ai/Trends-MCP)

### Other

*   [Awesome Agentic Commerce (⭐65)](https://github.com/MentionNetwork/awesome-agentic-commerce) - Curated list of agentic commerce resources: protocols (ACP, UCP, MCP), agent-readiness tools, and guides to make products visible to AI shopping agents.
